newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair shares lose more than five pct.
newsitem.headline: Swissair shares lose more than five pct.

text.p: Shares in Swissair AG extended early losses and were down more than five percent in afternoon trading as the market's high hopes were dashed by Swissair's news conference.
"This is a never-ending game with Swissair shares," said one dealer, noting some dealers had talked up the stock and now the news is out, everyone jumps ship.
At 1440 GMT Swissair's registered shares were down 60 Swiss francs, or 5.5 percent to 1,027 francs.
While Swissair's shares have been on a downward trend since late March, they suddenly reversed direction in early December, rising to 1,069 francs on December 17 from 970 francs on December 6.

The rise was attributed to speculation that Swissair's expected announcement of a holding structure would be combined with news of the sale or divestment of one or more profitable business units, such as Gate Gourmet.
There had also been speculation that Swissair would enter into a close cooperation with another airline.
